title: Elixir of Silvanus
summary: Immediately remove poison effects from yourself.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Immediately remove poison effects from yourself.
fields.Throw: Action. Throw up to 60 ft. The antidote affects creatures in a 3 ft radius and can leave an antidote cloud a creature may enter to benefit.
fields.Quest use: Can cure Thulla and certain At Death’s Door poisons. The pinned source describes the Mugwort recipe as pre-Patch 1.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
